subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C <inttypes.h> header. PARTIAL: re_std's dstdint.h carries every C99 format macro and none of the functions. Platform backend: the formats come from the platform's <inttypes.h> where it has one, and are supplied where it falls short -- a freestanding build need have only <stdint.h>, and an older library withholds them unless asked (__STDC_FORMAT_MACROS, which dstdint.h requests and then withdraws). Own backend: built from each family's description and the runtime's length modifiers. Missing: imaxdiv_t, imaxabs, imaxdiv, strtoimax / strtoumax, wcstoimax / wcstoumax, C23's binary formats and C2y's umaxabs.
legend_blurb: <inttypes.h> provides the printf and scanf format macros for the <stdint.h> types, and the greatest-width integer functions (imaxabs, imaxdiv, strtoimax, wcstoimax).

symbols.name: PRIdN / PRIiN (N = 8, 16, 32, 64)
symbols.notes: Own backend: built from each family's description and the runtime's length modifiers -- `I64` where C says `ll` on MinGW calling Microsoft's msvcrt.dll (RE_STD_INTERNAL_STDINT_MS_STDIO), which is also what mingw-w64's own <inttypes.h> does. t_dstdint.c prints each family's limits with these and checks the digits; built with -Wformat=2 -Werror, the compiler also checks each format against its argument's type.
symbols.failure_reason: Ships at C99 under ISO strictness, below the workbook's C90 floor. Floor question, not a coverage gap: C90 has no <stdint.h>, and the one measured obstacle to a C90 path is syntax -- every // comment in dstdint.h and config.h is an error under -std=c89 -pedantic-errors. Where // is accepted (gcc -std=gnu89, measured; other C90 compilers that take // as an extension, unmeasured) the conformance harness passes on both backends: 184/184 checks on the platform's headers, 169/169 on the header's own definitions. See the (meta) C90-floor item.

symbols.name: SCNdN / SCNiN / SCNoN / SCNuN / SCNxN (N = 8, 16, 32, 64)
symbols.notes: The 8-bit formats need the `hh` modifier, which came with C99: they are left out below C99 (the 169-check run at gnu89), and on msvcrt.dll, whose scanf reads `hh` as `h` and writes two bytes through a pointer to one. Test with #ifdef SCNd8. Own backend: built from each family's description and the runtime's length modifiers -- `I64` where C says `ll` on MinGW calling Microsoft's msvcrt.dll (RE_STD_INTERNAL_STDINT_MS_STDIO), which is also what mingw-w64's own <inttypes.h> does. t_dstdint.c reads every limit back with these.

symbols.name: imaxdiv_t
symbols.notes: Not provided. Visible through dstdint.h only incidentally, when the platform backend includes the platform's <inttypes.h>; absent on the own backend and on a freestanding build.
symbols.failure_reason: NOT IMPLEMENTED. C99 addition; re_std has no equivalent yet. Tracked on the <inttypes.h> roadmap entry.

symbols.name: imaxabs / imaxdiv
symbols.notes: Not provided. Trivial to implement on intmax_t; the open question is spelling (see the (meta) naming item), since the standard names are the platform's to declare.
symbols.failure_reason: NOT IMPLEMENTED. C99 addition; re_std has no equivalent yet. Tracked on the <inttypes.h> roadmap entry.

symbols.name: strtoimax / strtoumax
symbols.notes: Not provided. Old Microsoft runtimes had only _strtoi64 / _strtoui64 before VS2013. C2y lets base 8 take an 0o / 0O prefix, so a back-port must decide which edition it follows.
symbols.failure_reason: NOT IMPLEMENTED. C99 addition; re_std has no equivalent yet. Tracked on the <inttypes.h> roadmap entry.

symbols.name: wcstoimax / wcstoumax
symbols.notes: Not provided. As strtoimax, over wchar_t -- 16 bits on Windows, 32 elsewhere.
symbols.failure_reason: NOT IMPLEMENTED. C99 addition; re_std has no equivalent yet. Tracked on the <inttypes.h> roadmap entry.

symbols.name: PRIbN / SCNbN, and the LEAST, FAST, MAX and PTR families
symbols.notes: C23's %b conversion. Not provided, and not providable by a macro alone: the format is only as good as the runtime's printf, and a pre-C23 printf has no %b. A back-port needs re_std's own formatting function, not a format string.
symbols.failure_reason: NOT IMPLEMENTED. C23 addition; re_std has no equivalent yet. Tracked on the <inttypes.h> roadmap entry.

symbols.name: PRIBN (and families)
symbols.notes: C23, OPTIONAL: defined only where the runtime's printf supports %B. Same constraint as PRIbN.
symbols.failure_reason: NOT IMPLEMENTED. C23 addition; re_std has no equivalent yet. Tracked on the <inttypes.h> roadmap entry.

symbols.name: umaxabs
symbols.notes: C2y working draft (N3349 added an unsigned-result absolute value family without undefined behaviour; N3577 renamed uimaxabs to umaxabs). May change before ratification.
symbols.failure_reason: NOT IMPLEMENTED. C2y (draft) addition; re_std has no equivalent yet. Tracked on the <inttypes.h> roadmap entry.

symbols.name: __STDC_VERSION_INTTYPES_H__
symbols.notes: As __STDC_VERSION_STDINT_H__: the platform's claim, not re_std's.
symbols.failure_reason: Deliberately not provided: a conformance claim belongs to the platform. Listed so the C23 surface is complete.
